detail.longDescription: Australia's economy has almost doubled in size since 2000. So why do many Australians feel like living standards have become harder to improve? In Part 1 of my new series, I explore the growing gap between headline economic growth and GDP per capita, and why this distinction matters. # Economics # Australia # Productivity # GDP # LivingStandards https:// travis.nice.id.au/australias-e conomy-keeps-growing-so-why-dont-we-feel-richer
